allocation.note: every fresh node in the window is allocated by a call through the allocator slot with a constant size: 0x7f8 for a leaf node (11 elements of 0xb0 bytes, 11 keys, parent pointer, child index, count, 12 edge slots) and 0x858 for an internal node (the same layout plus 0x60 bytes); every fresh node is initialised with a zero parent pointer at +0x790 and a zero count at +0x7f2 (27 sites each)

alloc_body.role: shared allocator body bound to GOT slot 0x64df480

caller_a.role: insert-or-assign driver, clone family 1: the element arrives as the 4th argument; forwards it to wrap_a or copies it wholesale (0xb0 memcpys)

caller_b1.role: insert-or-assign driver, clone family 2 (full form): element argument forwarded to wrap_b or copied wholesale

caller_b2.role: insert-or-assign driver, clone family 2 (thin adapter form): forwards the element argument to wrap_b

caller_c.role: insert-or-assign driver, clone family 3: element argument forwarded to wrap_c or copied wholesale

dealloc_body.role: shared sized-deallocation body bound to GOT slot 0x64df4a0

giant_a1.role: insert + split-propagation giant, clone family 1; only E8 caller is wrap_a

giant_a2.role: insert + split-propagation giant, clone family 2; only E8 caller is wrap_b

giant_a3.role: insert + split-propagation giant, clone family 3; only E8 caller is wrap_c

giant_b1.role: bulk-build insert giant, clone family 1; only E8 callers are init_b1a and init_b1b

giant_b2.role: bulk-build insert giant, clone family 2; only E8 callers are init_b2a and init_b2b

giant_b3.role: bulk-build insert giant, clone family 3; only E8 callers are init_b3a and init_b3b

init_b1a.role: flat-to-tree build initialiser, clone family 1 (single-element and partitioned paths), calls giant_b1

init_b1b.role: flat-to-tree build initialiser, clone family 1 (second entry), calls giant_b1

init_b2a.role: flat-to-tree build initialiser, clone family 2, calls giant_b2

init_b2b.role: flat-to-tree build initialiser, clone family 2 (second entry), calls giant_b2

init_b3a.role: flat-to-tree build initialiser, clone family 3, calls giant_b3

init_b3b.role: flat-to-tree build initialiser, clone family 3 (second entry), calls giant_b3

wrap_a.role: insert wrapper, clone family 1: root-leaf fast path (0x7f8 allocation + one 0xb0 element memcpy), else dispatches to giant_a1

wrap_b.role: insert wrapper, clone family 2: same shape as wrap_a, dispatches to giant_a2

wrap_c.role: insert wrapper, clone family 3: same shape as wrap_a, dispatches to giant_a3

question: PR #2561 proved the eight element fields the join callee reads are written by no body in the consumption window. Who writes them?  This packet traces the allocation and insertion paths of the sibling-search node layout outward from its handle constructors and censuses every store into a new element.
verdict: the element builder for the sibling-search node layout never writes the eight join-callee fields individually: across the 19 pinned builder bodies (3 insert wrappers, 3 insert/split giants, 6 build initialisers, 3 bulk-build giants, 4 insert-or-assign drivers; 5,506 decoded instructions) there is no store at any of the eight displacements through a non-stack address, and every element-derived store is the displacement-0 head qword (21 sites).  Elements enter nodes only as wholesale copies of an already-built element image: 22 whole-element 0xb0 memcpys, 51 tail 0xa8 memcpys paired with head-qword stores, and 15 whole-element memmove shifts.  The image itself arrives as the drivers' caller-supplied element argument; its per-field writer is above that boundary.
